exact_echo_collapse_theorem.angle_coordinates: put u=x^2+x^-2, v=y^2+y^-2 and C_0(z)=2, C_1(z)=z, C_r(z)=z*C_(r-1)(z)-C_(r-2)(z); then B_r=-C_r(u)C_r(v)
exact_echo_collapse_theorem.coefficient_interpretation: u+v=(a_D^2-2*b_D)/q up to the sign convention for a_(D,2); the whole echo sequence sees only (u*v,(u+v)^2), hence loses the simultaneous sign (u,v)->(-u,-v)
exact_echo_collapse_theorem.consequence: no B_r with r>=3 supplies an independent pointwise detector coordinate beyond (B_1,B_2)

exact_haar_baseline.deduced_pairwise_orthogonality: Haar(B(U^r)*B(U^s))=0 for 1<=r!=s<=8; the same support argument proves it for every distinct positive r,s
exact_haar_baseline.scope: exact compact-group integrals; the pushforward U->U^r is not asserted to preserve Haar measure

strictly_distinct_mixed_third_moments.all_power_theorem: for every 1<=r<s<t, Haar(B_r*B_s*B_t) is zero unless r+s=t; on that additive resonance it is -2 when r=1 and -4 when r>=2
strictly_distinct_mixed_third_moments.proof: write B_r=-A_r(x)A_r(y), A_r(z)=z^(2r)+z^(-2r). The zero Fourier coefficient of A_r*A_s*A_t occurs exactly at r+s=t and equals 2. The C2 density changes the torus value -4 only when the next Fourier frequency is 4, which occurs exactly at r=1; its four axis terms contribute +2
